name: Best Streamer
storyline: In the neon-lit, cutthroat world of online broadcasting, you start with nothing but a basic PC and a burning ambition to become the world's #1 streamer. But the climb to the top is treacherous. You must navigate a complex landscape where viewers are currency and rivals are obstacles to be removed. Will you build a loyal community through pure talent and high-quality content, or will you descend into the shadows, using 'alternative' tactics like swatting and lethal force to eliminate the competition? In this world, the line between a content creator and a criminal mastermind is thin, and you must decide exactly how much a follower's life is worth.
summary: A PC, a camera, and a burning ambition. How far are you willing to go to become the #1 streamer on the planet? In this simulation, you don’t just broadcast; you build an empire, eliminate your competition, and fight for survival in a world where views are worth more than lives.
